articles.title: Flathub ve Fedoře, Ubuntu s lepším šifrováním disku

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v KDE: nejen střídání dne a noci, týden v GNOME #210: vylepšení knihovny Libadwaita, vydán Wayback 0.2 pro běh X11 desktopů na Waylandu, Intel XeSS 2.1 přináší Frame Generation i pro neIntelovská GPU, stále ale má uzavřený kód.
articles.title: Linus Torvalds stále používá Radeon RX 580, Linux se blíží ke 3% zastoupení na Steamu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Byly doby, kdy balíčkovací systémy se závislostmi dávaly smysl. Ty doby jsou pryč a svět linuxových distribucí by se měl konečně pohnout dál. Tolik jeden názor.
articles.title: RPM, DEB, anebo něco zcela jiného – pár slov k nadcházející linuxové ®evoluci

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Dnes si popíšeme některé funkce (resp. pseudofunkce) vestavěné do překladače GCC, které jsou určeny pro provádění nízkoúrovňových aritmetických operací. Díky nim lze realizovat vícebajtovou aritmetiku atd.
articles.title: Funkce vestavěné v GCC pro provádění nízkoúrovňových aritmetických operací

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Přesně podle plánu vyšel po dvou letech nový Debian 13 s kódovým jménem Trixie. Jeho plnohodnotná podpora poběží do roku 2028, přičemž předchozí Debian 12 Bookworm bude podporován ještě rok. Pokud tedy nechcete přejít na omezenější podporu LTS, máte zhruba dvanáct měsíců na aktualizaci.
articles.title: Debian 13 Trixie přináší podporu RISC-V a vylepšený balíčkovací systém

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: StarFive spustilo na Kickstarteru kampaň s VisionFive 2 Lite. Jde o menšího bratříčka VisionFive 2 z roku 2022, o kterém jsme tu psali. Procesor je StarFive JH7110S, což je v podstatě JH7110 (4 jádra SiFive U74 – RV64GC) s frekvencí sníženou z 1,5 GHz na 1,25 GHz.
articles.title: VisionFive 2 Lite s RISC-V na Kickstarteru

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Možná si někteří z vás vzpomenou na PC z doby 486 a tlačítko turbo (samozřejmě bylo stále zapnuté). Nové herní notebooky Dell a Alienware mají tlačítko, které se nazývá G-Mode nebo  Performance Boost. Má na jedno stisknutí zvýšit výkon ve hrách a přejít na profil s vysokým výkonem.
articles.title: Jádro 6.17 přidá tlačítko „turbo“

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump včera napsal na Truth Social, aby odstoupil generální ředitel Intelu Lip-Bu Tan. Problémem jsou zřejmě předchozí vazby na Čínu před příchodem do Intelu.
articles.title: Donald Trump chce, aby odstoupil generální ředitel Intelu Lip-Bu Tan

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Včera vyšlo třetí opravné vydání Ubuntu 24.04.03 LTS. Nově je pro HWE (hardware enablement) dostupné jádro 6.14 z Ubuntu 25.04.
articles.title: Vyšlo Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS s HWE jádrem 6.14

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Knižní edice správce české národní domény přináší novou knihu zkušeného programátora Pavla Tišnovského s názvem Programovací jazyk Go. Publikace nabízí srozumitelný a prakticky zaměřený pohled na programování v tomto moderním jazyce. Nejedná se však o klasickou učebnici, ale spíše o průvodce pro vývojáře, kteří s Go začínají, nebo pro ty, kdo hledají odpovědi na konkrétní otázky či inspiraci k dalšímu objevování.
articles.title: V edici CZ.NIC vychází nová kniha Pavla Tišnovského o jazyku Go

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Projekt AlmaLinux oznámil dostupnost balíčků nabízejících nativní podporu ovladačů karet Nvidia, včetně CUDA a Secure Boot, pro vydání AlmaLinux 9 a 10. Podrobnosti o balíčcích je možné najít na projektové wiki.
articles.title: Podpora karet Nvidia pro linuxovou distribuci AlmaLinux 9 a 10

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Masahiro Yamada byl po osm let jediným správcem systémů sestavování a konfigurace linuxového jádra – dvou důležitých částí infrastruktury, se kterými mnoho lidí pracuje, ale málokdo jim skutečně rozumí. Yamada ale z této pozice odstoupil. Bylo příjemné refaktorovat a vylepšovat systém sestavování jádra, ale z osobních důvodů se domnívám, že je pro mě obtížné v této roli pokračovat, napsal Yamada ve svém e-mailu.
articles.title: Změna správce nástrojů kbuild a kconfig

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Certifikační autorita Let's Encrypt uzavřela svůj roční plán postupného ukončování služby OCSP. Ta nabízí použití stejnojmenného protokolu k ověřování stavu certifikátů a umožňuje klientům (například webovým prohlížečům) zjistit, zda je certifikát stále platný, nebo zda byl autoritou odvolán.
articles.title: Let's Encrypt ukončil podporu služby OCSP

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Lukáš Morávek)
articles.description: Společnost Proxmox vydala stabilní verzi Proxmox Backup Server 4.0, která je již dostupná ke stažení. Nová generace zálohovacího řešení je postavena na systému Debian 13 „Trixie“ a přináší řadu zásadních vylepšení včetně podpory jádra Linux 6.14.8-2 a ZFS 2.3.3.
articles.title: Proxmox Backup Server 4.0 vydán ve stabilní verzi

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Ansible je automatizační nástroj, který umožňuje zjednodušit centrální instalaci, konfiguraci a provoz Linuxových serverů a aplikací. Připravili jsme pro vás školení, které je určeno pro správce systémů, kteří chtějí Ansible začít používat pro automatizaci opakujících se činností. Bude se hodit i vývojářům, kteří občas nasazují aplikace do testovacích prostředí.
articles.title: Ansible: efektivní nasazení a provoz, školení s dotací Úřadu práce

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: johny)
articles.description: Na platforme OpenRouter sa objavil záhadný model s názvom horizon-beta, ktorý vzbudzuje veľkú zvedavosť v AI komunite. Ide o „cloaked" (zahalenú/tajnú) verziu, ktorá bola sprístupnená verejnosti najmä za účelom testovania a získavania spätnej väzby. Prompt a výstupy sú zhromažďované pre ďalšie zlepšovanie modelu.
articles.title: Záhadný model Horizon Beta exceluje v generovaní kódu a dizajne

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Lukáš Morávek)
articles.description: Vývojáři dnes oznámili vydání první stabilní verze Proxmox Virtual Environment 9.0. Nová verze běží na Debianu 13 „Trixie“ a jako výchozí jádro používá Linux 6.14.8-2.
articles.title: Vyšla stabilní verze Proxmox VE 9.0, postavená na Debianu 13

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Do vydání Debianu 13 zbývá sotva pár dní, a tak Phoronix otestoval výkon oproti Debianu 12 na platformě s dvojicí procesorů EPYC 9965, tedy celkem 384 CPU jádry / 768 SMT vlákny a celkovým TDP obou procesorů 1 000 W. Ani operační paměti nebylo zrovna málo, rovný jeden a půl terabajt. Nic, co by mělo vypovídací hodnotu pro domácího uživatele.
articles.title: Procesory AMD EPYC jsou s Debianem 13 o 13 % rychlejší než na Debianu 12

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Organizace PCI-SIG oznámila, že i pro osmou generaci rozhraní PCI Express počítá se zdvojnásobením přenosových rychlostí. Ve výsledku tak v roce 2028 nabídne PCI Express 8.0 přenosovou rychlost 256 GT/s, tedy pri PCI Express ×1 slot obousměrnou rychlost 64 GB/s a pro PCI Express ×16 slot rychlost 1 TB/s.
articles.title: PCI Express 8.0 nabídne v roce 2028 až 1 TB/s

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nadace Godot oznamuje, že herní engine má nového platinového sponzora. Je jím společnost JetBrains stojící za známými produkty typu IntelliJ IDEA či PhpStorm.
articles.title: JetBrains je nový platinový sponzor enginu Godot

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Jádro Linux 6.17 dostává schopnost číst data ze senzorů napájecího zdroje Corsair HX1200i (2025). Tento 1200W 80Plus Platinum model disponující mimo jiné dvěma 16pin PCIe5 napájecími konektory se řadí mezi (nej)vyšší typy na trhu a podporuje sledování provozních parametrů přes na USB založené, avšak proprietární rozhraní Corsair LINK.
articles.title: Podpora napájecího zdroje Corsair HX1200i (2025) míří do jádra Linux 6.17

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Svatopluk Vít)
articles.description: Včera v pondělí 4.8. 2025 byl ve Sbírce zákonů zveřejněn zákon 264/2025 Sb. O kybernetické bezpečnosti. Jde o transformaci evropské vyhlášky zvané NIS2 v do podoby českého zákona.
articles.title: Zákon o kybernetické bezpečnosti vyšel ve Sbírce zákonů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Dlouhé měsíce vývoje směřující do bodu, kdy openSUSE vyjde s novým instalátorem a také posune Xfce do Wayland éry, se blíží ke konci. Na světě je Release Candidate nové verze openSUSE Leap 16.0, která nejen toto nabízí.
articles.title: OpenSUSE Leap 16.0 ve fázi RC, přináší nový instalátor či Xfce na Waylandu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Z obchodů Steam a Itch.io byly staženy NSFW hry kvůli karetním společnostem Visa a MasterCard. Společnost MasterCard však v pátek vydala krátké prohlášení:
articles.title: MasterCard vydal prohlášení, že nestojí za zákazem prodeje NSFW her

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: johny)
articles.description: V prehliadači Microsoft Edge bol nedávno predstavený nový experimentálny režim s názvom Copilot Mode. Tento mód výrazne posúva možnosť využitia AI priamo v prehliadači. Po aktivácii sa hlavná stránka nového panelu premení na jednoduché vstupné pole, ktoré kombinuje vyhľadávanie, chat a navigáciu. Copilot dokáže analyzovať všetky otvorené karty naraz, porozumieť kontextu nášho prehliadania a podľa potreby ponúknuť zhrnutia, porovnávanie alebo rýchle odporúčania – bez nutnosti neustále prepínať panely.
articles.title: Edge Copilot Mode - Microsoft postupne mení spôsob webového prehliadania

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Mastercard, Visa a další společnosti donutily Steam a Itch.io, aby z obchodu odstranily NSFW (not safe for work) hry. V pátek začal obchod Itch.io vracet hry, které odstranil.
articles.title: Itch.io vrací NSFW hry, zatím ty zdarma

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Oblíbená aplikace zaměřená na blokování reklamy Pi-hole měla minulé pondělí bezpečnostní problém. Přes zranitelný plugin GiveWP WordPressu, kterým mohou uživatelé posílat dobrovolné příspěvky na vývoj, unikly jména a e-mailové adresy dárců.
articles.title: Pi-hole mělo zranitelný plugin WordPressu, unikly e-maily dárců

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Linux je v síťovém prostředí jako doma, může zastat prakticky všechny potřebné role od směrovače (router), přes DHCP, DNS až po souborový server Samba pro Microsoft Windows. Přijďte se to všechno naučit na naše třídenní školení s názvem Linux: správa počítačové sítě.
articles.title: Linux a správa počítačové sítě (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: vlna)
articles.description: Po útoku konzervativní skupiny na NSFW (not safe for work) obsah na Steamu a na Itch.io rozdává GOG.com v rámci protikampaně Freedom To Buy zdarma Postal 2 a dalších 12 NSFW her, některé s podporou běhu na Linuxu.

articles.description: Linus Torvalds has used his authority to reject the RISC-V architecture changes for the Linux 6.17 kernel. The RISC-V updates won't land this cycle and will need to try again for v6.18 later in the year. Linus refers to at least some of the proposed RISC-V code as garbage along with being submitted rather late during the merge window...
articles.title: Linus Torvalds Rejects RISC-V Changes For Linux 6.17: "Garbage"

articles.description: There were a lot of interesting changes that landed in GNOME's Mutter compositor codebase to end out the weekend and ahead of next month's big GNOME 49 release...
articles.title: GNOME Mutter On Wayland Adds ICC Profile Support, Backlight Improvements

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Like clockwork KDE developer Nate Graham is out with his weekly recap of all the interesting Plasma changes for the week. There continues to be a lot of feature work and polishing that is building up for the Plasma 6.5 desktop release...
articles.title: KDE Plasma 6.5 Continues Seeing More Features Added & Polishing

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Well, it's an unpleasant afternoon in Linux land with more signs of the ongoing impact from Intel's corporate-wide restructuring. Just after writing about Intel's CPU temperature monitoring driver now left unmaintained/orphaned, more patches hit the public Linux kernel mailing list to mark additional Intel drivers as orphaned and removing maintainer entries for Linux developers no longer at Intel...
articles.title: Additional Intel Linux Drivers Left Orphaned & Maintainers Let Go

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: There is yet more apparent fallout from Intel's recent layoffs/restructurings as it impacts the Linux kernel... The coretemp driver that provides CPU core temperature monitoring support for all Intel processors going back many years is now set to an orphaned state with the former driver maintainer no longer at Intel and no one immediately available to serve as its new maintainer...
articles.title: Intel CPU Temperature Monitoring Driver For Linux Now Unmaintained After Layoffs

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: We still don't know what's going to happen for Bcachefs in the Linux 6.17 kernel even with the merge window set to end on Sunday with the Linux 6.17-rc1 release. Linus Torvalds commented over one month ago that they would be parting ways for Linux 6.17. At the start of the Linux 6.17 merge window a Bcachefs pull request was submitted but nearly two weeks later it's still not been pulled and Linus Torvalds hasn't commented on the matter...
articles.title: Bcachefs Maintainer Comments On The LKML While Waiting To See What Happens

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: A few new firmware files were upstreamed today to the linux-firmware.git repository for supporting a new GFX12.0.1 (RDNA4) "Kicker" graphics processor. There was also an AMDGPU kernel graphics driver patch that just landed as well in Linux 6.17 for the RDNA4 Kicker variant...

Madden 26's multiplayer modes offer a lot of different options, and there's an underrated way of playing with your friend as part of the same squad.


The easiest way to play with a buddy is to challenge them H2H via friendlies. This will let you decide which of the two of your contests is the better player. But what if you and your buddy want to play together as part of the same squad? This can be done with a few tweaks and play as part of the same team (either in duos or three of you together).


Madden 26 2v2 and 3v3 online guide


Whether you're playing 2v2 or 3v3, the core process is the same. Playing 1v1 is easier, as you can use the online H2H mode to play. Results in friendlies don't matter, but if you're opting for 2v2 (or 3v3), the available options are in the Superstar mode and Madden Ultimate Team. I have always preferred the latter, so let's find out the exact steps.


Screenshot  by Destructoid



Load up Ultimate Team.


From the home screen, select Head 2 Head.


Select the Squads Season from all the available options.


In this mode, you can only play either in duos or as a squad.


Before sending invites to your friends, select a role you want to play. You can also choose to play any role.


Modify the lineups with the cards you have. The player creating the session will be in control of the squad and cards to use.


Send requests to friends who are online. Once they accept the requests, you can start your match and play together as a squad.



Screenshot by Destructoid


The similar option in Superstar mode is under Play a Friend. Again, you can invite up to two more friends, or just roll out in duos. Take note that your results in duos and trios will count and will have an impact on in-game progression. Hence, it's better to focus on the wins and coordinate well with your friends to raise the chances of a victory.

articles.description:
The Horizon franchise is one of Sony's best, both in terms of sales and quality. It's so good, in fact, that Tencent decided to liberally take a few pages out of its book, but overdid it a little, leading Sony to file a formal copyright lawsuit.


Now, however, Tencent's Horizon clone, called Light of Motiram, has been refurbished with new looks and content to differentiate it from Sony's IP. Any and all content resembling Horizon's assets, story, characters, or otherwise has been removed from promotional materials, including the game's Steam page. Additionally, its release date has been pushed back significantly, with Light of Motiram now slated for release in the fourth quarter of 2027.


Even now, Light of Motiram bares a close resemblance to Horizon. Image via Tencent


All this came as a result of Sony's vehement and angry lawsuit, where the company alleged Tencent significantly infringed on its Horizon IP by copying its content, art style, characters, story, and world, among other things. Sony notoriously did not spare words when speaking of Light of Motiram, which it called a “shameless... slavish clone,” and even cited its own fans who dubbed Motiram as “Horizon Zero Originality,” per Reuters.


The snarky lawsuit seems to have put enough pressure on Tencent, forcing the company to delay its game and remove anything that could be viewed as a “copy” of Horizon. And, from what I saw prior to Light of Motiram's updated promotional material, there was quite a lot of it. At first glance, you couldn't even tell if you were looking at an entirely new game or just another screenshot from the Horizon titles, and it only makes sense that Sony decided to do something about it. 


What the epilogue of the lawsuit will be now that Motiram's been remedied is anyone's guess, but I don't think these changes will be enough to satisfy a very disgruntled Sony.

There are many ways you can play Madden 26's multiplayer modes, and it's a different type of fun when you're playing with your friends.


You can not only play against your friends in friendlies, but you can also be part of the same squad and play together. Let's find out what you need to do to play with your friends, and this option can be expanded further with crossplay.


How to play Madden 26 with your friends?


The easiest way to play with your friends in Madden 26 is the H2H mode.



Load up the game.


From the list of available modes, select Online H2H.


Pick Play a Friend. You can use this mode to play against strangers on the internet.


To select your friend, open the EA app overlay on PC. The overlay is available by default on consoles.


You'll find a list of all your available friends who are online. You can only send a match request to a friend who is currently online in Madden 26.


You can add your friend to the EA's friend list via their username/player ID.



Once you send the request, your friend will have to accept it to join the same lobby. You can change the default settings to enjoy more options. This includes fixing the game style in discussion with your friend. You can also change the quarter length, injuries, and more.


Screenshot by Destructoid


While all games happen with the default squad, you can use a custom squad with your friend. You can go with an alternate depth chart that is separate from the default list.


H2H friendlies are purely for bragging rights. There are no consequences of wins and losses, and no in-game rewards to obtain. However, it's fun and allows you to establish your virtual NFL supremacy in your friend circle.


It's always good to surprise your friends with some underrated tactics, and mastering the read option can be one such move. The ability to pull an unexpected move can trump even the most experienced players.

Indie co-op survival adventure PEAK has announced its first major expansion, and it's coming right after the weekend.


Titled Mesa, the upcoming update will be the first major expansion in the game's history. The developers shared a small trailer ahead of the launch, which gave a few ideas about the general theme of the new content. What makes me happy is knowing the launch date, so that my buddies and I can prepare accordingly.


PEAK's Mesa update should be the perfect excuse to pick up the game


PEAK is arguably one of the most fun games I have played with friends, and minor updates have added to the entertainment value. Who could have foreseen the cannibalism update that has been added as actual content? So far, the content updates have been minor, as the focus has been on bug fixes.


Come Aug. 11, that will all change. The Mesa update's trailer might also have revealed what we can expect. There should be a new biome if the cactus is anything of significance. I am more interested in seeing how the new biome fits in with the existing ones on the island.




If you thought survival on the island was hard, it could become even more difficult. We could be getting tornadoes as part of the Mesa update. Of course, this is purely my speculation based on the trailer, but surviving a full-scale tornado might make all our lives pretty difficult.


The developers haven't announced the exact release time, but the update goes live on Monday. Additionally, we can also look forward to an exclusive quest that PEAK will have with Discord. This limited-time quest will be live between Aug. 11 and Aug. 17, and allow you to unlock your very own Bing Bong avatar.


I have also noticed that there's a host of new achievements, which are likely going to be added to the game related to the upcoming update. For the time being, the only option is to wait patiently for Monday to arrive.

MGS Delta: Snake Eater, the remake of Metal Gear Solid 3, is not going to launch with its planned multiplayer mode, Fox Hunt. This new online component will differ from previous iterations, such as Metal Gear Online, and should come within a few months after release.


Though Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is still aiming to release worldwide and on all major platforms on Aug. 28, its online component, called Fox Hunt, will be put off for a few months. According to IGN, Konami did not specify when exactly Fox Hunt is to be added to MGS Delta, but said it'll be this Fall, i.e., between September and December. 


MGS Delta is a remake of 2004's stellar tactical-espionage-action game MGS3. Screenshot via Konami YouTube


As opposed to previous online Metal Gear modes, such as Metal Gear Online that came with Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots, Fox Hunt is a unique and specially designed mode tied solely to this new Metal Gear title. As Yu Sahara, a long-time Metal Gear Solid developer, told IGN, Fox Hunt is “a completely original” mode with “completely different” gameplay to MGS Delta: Snake Eater. 


He added that Fox Hunt will be focused on survival and stealth and be “more than just a shootout,” explaining the mode should take “camouflage and hide and go seek to the next level.” 


Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is a remake of the 2004 classic stealth-action game Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater, directed by the one and only Hideo Kojima. It aims to maintain the original's core design philosophy and stick as closely to it as possible while expanding mechanics and introducing waves of quality-of-life improvements, among other things. 


It is slated for release on Aug. 28, though unfortunately without its multiplayer component. 


The post Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater won’t launch with its multiplayer mode, but should get it this fall appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater won’t launch with its multiplayer mode, but should get it this fall

As I attempt to gracefully age into my elder years as a gamer who just so happens to write about their hobby as a career, I'm generally a pretty happy person on any given day, and I'm thankful for that.

Battlefield 6 has only just begun its early access open beta window, and we already have reports of cheaters in the game. What we believed was impossible given EA's heavily intrusive anti-cheat measures became reality within hours of the beta's launch, and it can only get worse from here.

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Major academic publishers, including Elsevier and Springer Nature, are trying to unmask the operators of several shadow libraries including Anna’s Archive, Z-Library and Libgen. They're also targeting SLUM, a third-party uptime monitor for these unofficial libraries. A DMCA subpoena, issued by a D.C. federal court, requires Cloudflare to hand over identifying user data for possible legal action.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Publishing Giants Escalate War on ‘Shadow Libraries’ With Broad Cloudflare Subpoena

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Reports that the Nigerian Copyright Commission had recently shut down a pirate site didn't sound especially interesting. Operating under MovieBox branding, currently seen on endless domains, the local site reportedly received over 130 million visits in the previous three months and was actually still in business. Indeed, plans to develop the MovieBox brand began last month, with an application for intellectual property protection underpinning all kinds of business opportunities.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MovieBox is Still Alive and Preparing to Fight Intellectual Property Thieves

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Paris Judicial Court has ordered top VPN providers to block yet more pirate sports streaming domains. Two rulings dated July 18th side with broadcasters beIN Sports and Canal+, rejecting the VPN providers' arguments that these blocking measures are ineffective, costly, and technically difficult to implement. A request from CyberGhost and ExpressVPN, to pause the case and refer questions to the EU's highest court, was also rejected.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: French Court Orders VPNs to Block More Pirate Sites, Rejects EU Court Referral

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Brazil's National Telecommunications Agency has reported a significant operation targeting a group who smuggled pirate IPTV devices from neighboring Paraguay, for distribution and nationwide sale in Brazil. Thirty-eight police officers executed 12 warrants, seizing vehicles, real estate, and other property, with assets worth up to US$6m frozen by a court. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Police Raid IPTV Pirates, Freeze $6m in Assets, Seize Vehicles & Real Estate

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
After focusing on IPTV services offering pirated live football matches from Italy's Serie A, legal amendments adopted by telecoms regulator AGCOM last week will widen the scope of the Piracy Shield blocking platform. The now-infamous claim, that pirate streams will be blocked inside 30 minutes, now applies to movie and TV premieres, and other events broadcast live. The more serious issues concern VPNs, DNS providers and whoever AGCOM decides to pursue next.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Piracy Shield Widens Scope to Protect Movie & TV Premieres & Live Music

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After years of legal skirmishes, an ambitious strategy by film studio Voltage Pictures, to sue alleged BitTorrent pirates through a reverse class action in Canada, has been permanently shut down. The Federal Court of Appeal ruled that these cases, where IP addresses are the main initial evidence, are unsuited to this legal approach. Furthermore, the proposed methods for mass notification are deemed unlawful.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Canadian Court Rejects Reverse Class Action Lawsuit Against BitTorrent Pirates

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? '28 Years Later' tops the chart, followed by 'Thunderbolts'. 'How to Train Your Dragon' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 08/04/2025

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
With two pirate site blocking bills under discussion in the U.S., and a third expected in the weeks ahead, a key statistic seems to be shrinking. During 2024 it was claimed that site blocking is a common tool in ~60 countries, a figure now reframed as "50 democratic countries" in the latest blocking bill. Yet if countries are excluded from the total on the basis they have never blocked, no longer block, or fail to meet the democratic threshold, the total may shrink to less than 40.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Anti-Piracy Bills See Headline Blocking Claim Squeezed By Democracy

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A man described by Sky as a "top level" pirate has agreed to pay the broadcaster €480,000 in damages. Sky's investigation of David Dunbar reportedly began on social media last November, but soon benefited from a timely anonymous tip from another country. In May 2025, Sky obtained a court order to secure evidence from Dunbar's home, but that didn't go according to plan. After being denied access to the premises, evidence was destroyed and funds were "dissipated".
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Operator Destroys Evidence Then Agrees to Pay Sky €580,000

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Business Court in Brussels, Belgium, has issued a broad site-blocking order that aims to restrict access to shadow libraries including Anna's Archive, Libgen, OceanofPDF, Z-Library, and the Internet Archive's Open Library. In addition to ISP blocks, the order also directs search engines, DNS resolvers, advertisers, domain name services, CDNs and hosting companies to take action. For now, Open Library doesn't appear to be actively blocked.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Belgium Targets Internet Archive’s ‘Open Library’ in Sweeping Site Blocking Order (Update)

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Efforts to introduce pirate site blocking to the United States continue with the introduction of the "Block BEARD" bill in the Senate. The bipartisan proposal, backed by Senators Tillis, Coons, Blackburn, and Schiff, aims to create a new legal mechanism to combat foreign piracy websites. Block BEARD is similar to the previously introduced House bill "FADPA", but doesn't directly mention DNS resolvers.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Senators Introduce New Pirate Site Blocking Bill: Block BEARD

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
DRM is crucial for protecting premium streaming content, with Microsoft's PlayReady a leading solution used by giants including Netflix, Amazon, and Disney+. When cracks appeared in PlayReady's armor recently, Microsoft took swift action, asking GitHub to remove a series of leaked SL3000 certificates. It appears that Amazon also responded by indefinitely suspending subscribers who attempted to try out leaked credentials.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: PlayReady DRM Leak Triggers Microsoft Takedown and Amazon Account Suspensions

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
With site-blocking legislation currently under discussion in the United States, a new report examines site blocking measures elsewhere in the world. Commissioned by Cloudflare, the report warns that a patchwork of measures risks disruption to the internet's global technical infrastructure. It also questions whether the claimed benefits are worth the risk in the bigger picture. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: The Risks of Pirate Site Blocking, Who Benefits, Who Pays, And at What Cost?

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Medical device associations behind a lawsuit challenging a Library of Congress exemption to the DMCA's anti-circumvention provisions, have failed to have the exemption ruled illegal. Motions for summary judgment from both sides went in favor of the defendants after a district court judge found that the exemption, granted for the maintenance and repair of medical devices, permits a non-infringing, transformative fair use.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ‘Fair Use’ Prevails as Library of Congress Wins DMCA Anti-Circumvention Battle

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Facebook has several anti-piracy tools and technologies to keep problematic content off the platform. This apparently includes automated keyword filters that ban mentions of piracy-related terms, regardless of the context. This resulted in the removal of several MagisTV news articles, including a press release from anti-piracy coalition ACE. Trying to spot these errors is not without risk either, as Facebook bans repeat offenders.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Facebook Rigorously Removes News Articles Mentioning Pirate Service “MagisTV”

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
In Q2 2025, anti-piracy coalition Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment continued to 'seize' domains in bulk, adding to the world's largest collection of former pirate domains maintained by the MPA. While the archive contains countless unique and memorable domains, many with interesting and informative backstories, new additions illustrate typical responses to site blocking measures and very little else.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ACE & MPA Continued to Scoop Up Pirate Domains in Bulk During Q2 2025

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A new report investigates the cybersecurity risks consumers face when using digital piracy services in Southeast Asia. The findings clearly show that pirate sites are a bigger threat than legal streaming platforms, suggesting that countermeasures are warranted. However, does is also mean that pirates are 65 times more likely to be infected by malware? And is that even important?
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Study Reveals a Malware Problem on Pirate Sites, but How Bad is It?

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Adult film producers Strike 3 Holdings and Counterlife Media have filed a significant copyright infringement lawsuit against tech giant Meta. A complaint filed at a California federal court alleges that their films were downloaded via BitTorrent for AI training purposes. With at least 2,396 movies at stake, potential damages could exceed 350 million dollars.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Copyright Lawsuit Accuses Meta of Pirating Adult Films for AI Training

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Top-tier Spanish football league LaLiga and Latin American anti-piracy group Alianza have joined forces to maintain the pressure on illegal IPTV service Magis TV. In conjunction with law enforcement partners in Argentina, multiple arrest warrants were executed in five regions against local sellers of premium Magis TV packages. Two of the locations targeted are operated by a local internet service provider; reports indicate that the owner of the ISP is now considered a fugitive.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Police, LaLiga & Alianza Target MagisTV With ISP Office Raids & Arrests

Pokud vám DNES připadá vtipná stará Bláznivá střela, tohle je její docela důstojné pokračování. Já s překvapením zjistil, že mi dnes už tolik vtipná nepřipadá a její pokračování rozhodně lepší není. (Ilča 50 %)
Ta v podcastu zmiňovaná analýza "Připoutejte se, prosím" je tady.
articles.title: Audio recenze: Bláznivá střela [The Naked Gun] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Mladí sourozenci Philippouovi jsou rozhodně velice talentovaní a dokážou vytvořit extrémně hutnou atmosféru a postavy, se kterými se divák identifikuje. Což je v dnešních hororech skoro zázrak. Velkým plusem je krátká délka (pod 100 minut) a ani mi moc nevadilo, že některé nuance příběhu zůstaly nevysvětleny (což mi normálně vadí). (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio dvojrecenze: Vrať mi ji / Mluv se mnou - oba 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Prvních přibližně 20 minut jsem byl skoro nadšený. Mělo to švih, krásnou retrofuturistickou výpravu, bylo to (záměrně!) mírně debilní jako sci-fi z 50. let, ale... Pak většina z toho zmizela (včetně té výpravy!) a zbytek filmu je zase totéž jako většina ostatních Marvel filmů: dvě-tři větší akce, trocha triviální filosofie o smyslu rodiny a přátelství, a na konci slib, že "v příštím pokračování to ale opravdu bude stát za to!" (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Fantastická 4: První kroky [The Fantastic Four: First Steps] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Pokud jste extrémní fanoušci původních filmů, dobře je znáte a pokládáte je za kultovní, pak s tímto pokračováním (opravdu pokračováním, ne remakem) asi budete spokojeni. Já fanoušek originálu nejsem, čekal jsem něco potenciálně inovativního nebo zajímavého a nedočkal jsem se. (Ilča 20 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Tajemství loňského léta (2025) [I Know What You Did Last Summer] - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description:
Ne že bych jméno "Christopher Guest" vůbec neznal, ale až dnes mi došlo, že tyto tři velmi rozdílné role v mých oblíbených retrofilmech This is Spinal Tap, Princezna nevěsta a Pár správných chlapů hraje tentýž člověk.

Který, mimochodem, je skutečný nefalšovaný baron a má už 40 let za manželku Jamii Lee Curtisovou.
Tomu říkám široký záběr.
(Tento post nemá žádný skrytý hlubší smysl.)
articles.title: Zcela náhodný Christopher Guest

articles.description:
Aurélien Aptel discovered that cifs-utils invoked a shell when requesting a
password. In certain environments, a local attacker could possibly use this
issue to escalate privileges. (CVE-2020-14342)

It was discovered that cifs-utils incorrectly used host credentials when
mounting a krb5 CIFS file system from within a container. An attacker
inside a container could possibly use this issue to obtain access to
sensitive information. (CVE-2021-20208)

It was discovered that cifs-utils incorrectly handled certain command-line
arguments. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain root
privileges. (CVE-2022-27239)

It was discovered that cifs-utils incorrectly handled verbose logging. A
local attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive
information. (CVE-2022-29869)
articles.title: USN-7688-1: cifs-utils vulnerabilities

articles.description:
Jieyong Ma discovered that poppler incorrectly handled certain malformed
PDF files. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause poppler
to crash, resulting in a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu
16.04 LTS and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2022-27337)

Kevin Backhouse discovered that poppler incorrectly handled documents with
a large number of annotations. If a user or automated system were tricked
into opening a specially crafted document, a remote attacker could use
this issue to cause poppler to consume resources, leading to a denial of
service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-52886)
